name: local-bard
description: Local desktop app that captures a single application's audio output and streams it into a Discord voice channel via a self-controlled bot.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer && npm run copy:static
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit

//: electron-builder config lives in electron-builder.yml (not here) so it can carry real comments -- see the note there about auto-update. Opus encoding uses opusscript (pure JS) only, not @discordjs/opus -- see README's 'Dependency notes' section for why.
